scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start:dev -w @hackalem/api" "npm run dev -w @hackalem/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hackalem/api && npm run build -w @hackalem/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @hackalem/api && npm run lint -w @hackalem/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start:prod -w @hackalem/api" "npm run start -w @hackalem/web"
